name: ElevenLabs subscription
summary: Character usage and limit of your ElevenLabs subscription.
description: Reads your ElevenLabs character usage and limit with one documented GET /v1/user/subscription request per poll. The API key is stored encrypted, sent to the adapter over stdin and only to the ElevenLabs API. No other request is made.

errorActions.auth: Check that the ElevenLabs API key is valid and may read user data, enter it again and save.
errorActions.config: Set the ElevenLabs API key (and region, if you use data residency) in Usage settings, then save.

configSchema.label: ElevenLabs API key
configSchema.description: Write-only. If the key restricts endpoint access, allow reading user data.

configSchema.label: API region
configSchema.description: Leave on default unless your workspace uses ElevenLabs data residency.
